component.name: Paint.with.me
component.summary: Image editor for Linux in the style of Paint.NET

description.p: Paint.with.me is a free and open-source raster image editor with the familiar layout and workflow of Paint.NET, built natively for Linux with Qt. No Wine and no .NET runtime are needed.

ul.li: Layers with opacity and blend modes
Opens Paint.NET .pdn files with their layers
PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF and WebP
Brushes, selections, color adjustments, effects and a plugin system

description.p: Based on paint.software by Univers4craft. Not affiliated with Paint.NET or dotPDN LLC.
First release under the Paint.with.me name: English-only interface and new branding.
